test_modes.name: Loopback (FC-0/FC-1)
test_modes.purpose: Serial loopback to characterize the SerDes / encoding without a link partner.

test_modes.name: Link-init test
test_modes.purpose: Exercise the primitive-sequence protocol (NOS/OLS/LR/LRR) and IDLE exchange.

test_modes.name: Frame / CRC injection
test_modes.purpose: Inject CRC errors and verify discard + sequence recovery (ABTS).

spec_provided_observability.name: Link status / state
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Login state, current 24-bit FC address, negotiated GFC rate, BB_Credit, and Link Up/Down are observable in the controller status registers.

spec_provided_observability.name: Loss-of-sync / 8b10b / 64b66b code-violation counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: FC-1 error counters surface physical-layer signal integrity problems.

spec_provided_observability.name: CRC error counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: FC-2 32-bit CRC failures per frame are counted for reliability observability.

spec_provided_observability.name: Credit / R_RDY / ACK observability
spec_provided_observability.purpose: BB_Credit and EE_Credit accounting and primitive counts expose flow-control stalls.

spec_provided_observability.name: RSCN / State Change Notification
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Fabric Controller (0xFFFFFD) RSCN events report topology changes.

spec_provided_observability.name: Name Server query
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Name Server (0xFFFFFC) queries enumerate the fabric for debug/discovery.

error_detection_mechanisms: 32-bit CRC over the FC-2 frame header + data field detects frame corruption.
8b/10b running-disparity / code-violation detection (and 64b/66b sync-header errors) at FC-1.
Sequence-count (SEQ_CNT) gap detection for lost/out-of-order frames.
Credit-exhaustion / missing-R_RDY / missing-ACK detection for flow-control faults.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Fabric Controller notifies a topology change.
FC-2 delivers a frame / completes a sequence.

notes: Fibre Channel observability centers on link state, the FC-1 code/loss-of-sync counters, the FC-2 CRC counters, credit accounting, and fabric services (Name Server discovery, Fabric Controller RSCN). Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain HBA/controller integrator concerns.
